title: Easy to assemble, holds a lot of shoes
text: Easy to assemble, holds a lot of shoes. Great under bed storage.  These are super easy to assemble and hold lots of shoes or other items.  Clear cover keeps the dust off of stored items.  You'll receive two sets with this purchase.

product_metadata.title: HOONEX Under Bed Shoe Storage Organizer with Adjustable Dividers, Shoe Holder with Leather Handles, 2 Pack, Store 24 Pairs, Grey
features: Out Linen Fabric and Non-Woven Lining
Material & Dimension: This under bed shoe organizer is made of high-quality linen fabric, make it durable and stylish, all the materials are eco-friendly, the dimension is 5.3" H x 24.5" W x 32" L.

Adjustable Compartments: This shoe storage holder designed with adjustable compartments, which make it suit for storing various types of shoes and boots, like sandals, running shoes, hiking boots, women's boots and etc.

Sturdy Construction: the frame of the shoe container is made of thickened cardboard, which makes it sturdy to hold some heavy shoes/boots, also lets you move the shoe organizer with a full load without worrying of falling apart.
Clear Top Cover: the clear top cover is made of high-quality material, keep shoes/boots visible at glace and away from dust and moisture.
Leather Handles: The stylish leather carrying handles at two sides allow you to move the under bed shoe storage easily.
